why: RE-MEASURED after f9d6a7c10. The first attempt was VACUOUS - _world_counts never counted the `worlds` table, so a real delete produced an empty diff and the probe correctly refused to call that a pass. With the world ROW now in the snapshot the first call must MOVE the store (worlds 1 -> 0) before the second call's no-op means anything.

Archiving an already-archived template must not report success over zero rows. That exact defect - archived:true over 0 rows, with an undo hint - was found and fixed earlier in this loop, so this is its regression check.

why: Restoring an entity twice must not double-restore or corrupt it. The id is resolved from the store rather than typed, because the seed soft-deletes the row and no tool lists a deleted entity - which is D-RESTORE-WITH-NO-WAY-TO-SEE-WHAT-IS-RESTORABLE, this tool's own blocking finding.
